vo: Welcome to The Training Notebook One.
Thanks for your patience while we moved your account.
Here's how to build a new workout.
Open your client. Tap add workout, then build workout from scratch.
Give it a name, and pick a time.
Tap add exercise. Search for it, and tap it.
Type the weight and reps on the pad.
Tap clone last to copy the set.
Add the rest the same way.
To change the order, press and hold the handle, and drag.
For the next session, tap the three dots, then duplicate workout.
Tap add date, and pick the day.
If you need more help, just reply to this email.
